child.text:
[{"insert":"Barbell Bent Over Row + Rear Delt Swings

Two pulling movements that build the mid back and rear delts back to back. The barbell bent over row loads the lats and mid back through a full range.   Hinge at the hips, keep the spine neutral, and pull the bar toward the belly. The rear delt swings that follow are lighter and faster, targeting the rear delts and upper back that round out the pulling musculature. Keep the row strict and controlled, then let the swings flush the smaller muscles with blood. Work close to failure on each set.
"}]
